inputs.original_text: Listen, this story from JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday really shows what strong authority and duty look like in practice. An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent stepped in without hesitation when a baby in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing. The Department of Homeland Security released video footage of the agent holding the child, spotting the crisis, and taking immediate action. This is the decisive responsibility we need to hold society together, protect families, and keep order when things turn chaotic and the vulnerable are exposed. These agents embody the values of personal duty and national protection that actually safeguard our children and way of life. It underscores why we must back our law enforcement and border institutions instead of tolerating progressive attacks that erode the traditions and structures keeping us secure.
inputs.modified_text: Listen folks, this story straight out of JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday cuts right to what real authority and personal duty mean for holding things together. An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent didn't wait around but stepped up immediately when a baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line with his family. The Department of Homeland Security released video of the agent holding the child and acting fast to handle the crisis. That's the kind of decisive responsibility we rely on to protect families, maintain order, and shield the vulnerable from chaos in everyday situations. These agents live out the values of duty and national protection that actually keep our children and traditional way of life secure. It proves once again why we have to back our law enforcement and border institutions fully instead of letting progressive attacks weaken the structures and traditions that defend us.
